name: Carrot Juice
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as carrots are low FODMAP and the juice form may be easier to digest than whole carrots.
preparationTips: Choose 100% pure carrot juice without added sugars or high FODMAP ingredients
Fresh-pressed is ideal, but bottled varieties are acceptable if no additives
Consume chilled for best taste and digestive comfort
Start with smaller portions if you have severe digestive sensitivity
nutritionalHighlights: Provides natural sugars for quick energy
